description: This file declares the WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory class, which implements the IWebAudioPlayerTaskFactory interface for creating various WebAudioPlayer tasks such as play, pause, stop, setCaps, etc., within the Rialto server component. It includes dependencies on WebAudio-related interfaces and manages internal references to client and wrapper objects.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for creating WebAudioPlayer tasks such as play, pause, stop, setCaps, etc., for the Rialto server's WebAudio implementation.

methods.name: WebAudioPlayerTaskFactory
methods.description: Constructor initializing the factory with client and wrapper dependencies.

methods.name: createShutdown
methods.description: Creates a task to shut down the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createStop
methods.description: Creates a task to stop the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createPlay
methods.description: Creates a task to start playback on the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createPause
methods.description: Creates a task to pause playback on the WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createSetCaps
methods.description: Creates a task to set the media capabilities (e.g., MIME type, configuration) for WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createEos
methods.description: Creates a task to signal end-of-stream for WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createSetVolume
methods.description: Creates a task to set the volume level for WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createWriteBuffer
methods.description: Creates a task to write audio buffers to WebAudioPlayer.

methods.name: createHandleBusMessage
methods.description: Creates a task to handle bus messages from GStreamer related to WebAudioPlayer.
